If extensive troubleshooting a citrix profile is not resolving the issue or if there's something wrong with the profile itself, a full reset can be used.

This is a last resort as it resets everything to do with the profile. Should be used only as a last resort.

Go to the server location in File Explorer (by either typing in the main windows search bar or in the address line of File Explorer itself)

![[Pasted image 20241231124232.png]]
![[Pasted image 20241231124244.png]]

Once in this folder, select the folder that’s linked to the jurisdiction of your user (In this example, it'll be a Jersey user). Be sure to use the one that includes 'Profile'.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Find the name of the user you're looking for and add .old at the end. Once they log back it in, it will create a new folder and essentially, a new profile.

![[Pasted image 20241231124401.png]]
